paragraphs: He is mentioned in Keritot 21a, but Yoma 74b reads Rav Idi bar Avin.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Davidson Keritot 21a paragraph names Rav Ada bar Avin, whereas the selected Yoma 74b paragraph names Rav Idi bar Avin. Both source forms and locators are preserved as a textual comparison, without merging the figures or importing the surrounding legal discussion.
